core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Riyaz corresponds to the Arabic form رِيَاض (Arabic root ر و ض (r-w-ḍ); رِيَاض (Riyāḍ)). Its core sense is riyaz; gardens, meadows. Riyaz is a spelling variant of Arabic رِيَاض (Riyāḍ) 'gardens, meadows', the plural of رَوْضَة (rauḍa).
